grammar.summary: 本课学习被动语态与原因链叙事。

points.title: 被动叙事链
points.explanation: The firemen were puzzled / a snake was found / it was wound itself... 被动贯穿调查叙事：动作承受者为主线。

examples.en: The fire was caused by a snake which was wound around the electric wires.
examples.cn: 火灾是由缠在电线上的蛇引起的。

points.title: wound 缠绕（wind 的过去式）
points.explanation: wind→wound→wound（缠绕）；与 wound（伤口）同形异义，需按上下文判断。

examples.en: The snake had been attracted by the heat.
